A grayscale editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below it, the red text "JEJAK CIA" overlays a black banner reading "PADA TRAGEDI 1965". A line of text at the top reads "LIPUTAN KHUSUS 50 TAHUN G-30-S".

The central figure is a man with light-colored hair, wearing a light-colored suit and dark tie, walking forward. To his left is a man in a dark military uniform with a peaked cap and decorative cords. To his right and behind him are several men in uniform holding rifles with bayonets. In the background, a building with a tiled, gabled roof and several flags, including a visible United States flag, are visible. Large leafy trees stand behind the figures. 

In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode and text reading "RP 39.500". The bottom right corner has a caption: "Marshall Green, Duta Besar Amerika Serikat di Jakarta, Juli 1965." The image is composed of various figures and structures in a clear outdoor setting with visible shut-down buildings and flags.
